method: read-only critical analysis of saved Phase 13 evidence; no experiments rerun

notes: Phase 13C confirmatory seeds are 20-29; calibration seeds are 15-19. Its saved record is authoritative where a CLI completion line displayed calibration seeds.
Phase 13F seeds are 70-79. Interrupted attempt 01 remains preserved and excluded from the completed evidence package.
Phase 13C MEMORY_ONLY and Phase 13F B2_MEMORY_SKILL_STORE are different baselines in different protocols and metrics; they are not pooled.
Phase 13G is treated as a null for the bounded ARC adapter, not a general disproof of SCT or evidence that ARC lacks skills.
No Phase 13 outputs were modified; no experiment was rerun.
